name: ElevenReader
shortDescription: AI-powered text-to-speech reader converting books, articles, PDFs, and ePubs into lifelike audio across 90+ languages.
description: ElevenReader is an AI-driven listening application developed by ElevenLabs that converts uploaded PDFs, ePubs, web articles, newsletters, and documents into high-fidelity expressive audio. Powered by neural voice synthesis, ElevenReader features over 1,000 realistic voices, including an Iconic Voices collection, offline download capabilities, smart header and footer filtering, cross-device synchronization between web and mobile platforms, and an included catalog of over 200,000 audiobooks.

pricing.details: Free plan includes 10 hours of text-to-audio per month; Ultra plan ($11/month or $99/year) offers unlimited personal listening, offline downloads, and 200k+ audiobooks.

features: Context-aware neural text-to-speech with natural cadence and emotion
1,000+ lifelike voices across 90+ languages including iconic narrator voices
Universal document support for PDFs, ePub, DOCX, TXT, and web URLs
Smart file imports that filter out headers, footers, page numbers, and filler text
Offline audio downloading and cross-device listening state synchronization
Custom narrator design and 0.5x to 4.0x variable playback speed controls
useCases: Listening to dense research papers, PDF manuscripts, and industry newsletters on the go
Accessible reading support for users with ADHD, dyslexia, or visual impairments
Proofreading personal drafts and novel dialogue by hearing spoken pacing aloud
Converting long-form ebooks and web novel archives into personal audiobooks
limitations: Free tier is capped at 10 hours of audio generation per month
Audio is designed for personal in-app listening and cannot be exported as raw files
